title: ECP Ledger Entry
description: Append-only, hash-chained ledger entry of the ECP Registration Authority (R1-I, Option C minimal coupled foundation). The ledger is a plain-file directory of chained entries wrapping registration records. entry_hash = SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization of this document with the top-level entry_hash field removed. prev_entry_hash is the entry_hash of the previous entry (64 zeros for the genesis entry at index 1). Entries are never edited, removed or reordered; corrections are new superseding records; invalidations are explicit entries of kind 'invalidation'. The chain head is published via the ledger ANCHOR file and public Git anchoring. The kinds 'anchor' and 'store-checkpoint' are schema-reserved for future use; R1-I tooling writes only 'registration' and 'invalidation' entries.

entry_index.description: Monotone chain position (1-based). Chain position, not claimed_at, is the canonical order.

entry_kind.description: 'registration' wraps a new registration record; 'invalidation' explicitly invalidates an existing registration (record_ref points at the invalidated record); 'anchor' and 'store-checkpoint' are reserved for future phases.

registrar.description: Identity of the registrar performing the append (attribution, not authorization by itself).

record_hash.description: SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization of the referenced registration record document (the full record, not its internal registration_hash).

commitment.description: The ground-truth commitment frozen by this entry: equals the public case's ground_truth_reference.commitment and the protected store seal commitment (verified at registration time and re-verifiable from public data).

ground_truth_commitments.description: Ground-truth commitments bound by this entry. Registration entries MUST carry the commitment of every case version frozen by the referenced record (usually one); this makes the ledger an independent freeze-of-record for the commitments, not merely a pointer to public case documents.

claimed_at.description: Registrar-claimed timestamp. An assertion, not evidence: canonical order is the chain position; independent time evidence comes from external anchoring.

prev_entry_hash.description: entry_hash of the previous entry; exactly 64 zeros for the genesis entry (entry_index 1).

entry_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical serialization of this document with the top-level entry_hash field removed.
